criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Official workflow accepts product photos and Amazon/Shopify/eBay/Shopee links; exact ASIN identity in output and first-10-second visibility untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: No saved AIVP output or independent benchmark.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Editable timeline elements and chat revisions documented; cross-run stability untested.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Brief/photo/link to script, scenes, motion graphics, captions and audio is documented; setup and correction burden unmeasured.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: No AIVP timing, queue or failure artifacts.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Free Basic tier and clip credit table exist, but complete Video Agent project/export cost is not documented or measured.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Terms disclaim a Fotor copyright claim over user AIGC, but complete video/audio/template monetization rights are not explicit.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: No verified Video Agent API/MCP or editable-project export integration was established.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Browser workflow and ecommerce use cases fit creators/SMBs; Australia-specific availability, tax and billing are unverified.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: Official affiliate page names ShareASale and Impact and publishes headline commission/cookie claims; AIVP acceptance/tracking not yet verified.

analysis: Excellent documented product-link fit and editable workflow, but there is no AIVP output evidence and complete commercial-video rights/cost remain unresolved.
confidence_notes: Primary vendor documents plus Product Hunt distribution evidence only; no hands-on AIVP run.
